title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us — Episode8 Giving & Receiving

meta.Event Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Line: song00004_off_f
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's time for the MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Everybody
rows.Line: Moon Viewing Stream!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's finally the night of the 15th!
Just as we announced, we'll be making some dango and rabbit masks tonight!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you all ready?
We'll be able to take more questions than usual, so please feel free to ask in the comments section.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-N-D!
Shizuku's gonna be leading tonight's stream, so whatever happens, please try to go easy on her, okay?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Lead the way, Shizuku.>
<You can do it, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone.
I'll do my best to not disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, why don't we get started with making some dango? For this, we'll be using some mochi rice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, okay... Wait, rice?!
You make dango using rice?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, you're supposed to use dango flour...
Can I see your recipe, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, did I make a mistake?
This recipe says that we'll also need red bean paste and soybean powder...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it does... Hang on, this is a recipe for ohagi! What happened to the moon viewing dango recipe?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? I was so sure that I got the right recipe too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here, I just looked one up on my phone! We can use this recipe!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, do we even have the right ingredients for this? We probably bought the wrong stuff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That shouldn't be a problem. I made sure to buy extra just in case we ran out of anything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Good ol' Shizuku lol...>
<Ohagi sounds good too.>
<Nice save, Haruka!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Ohagi is a nice idea.
Maybe we can do that during another stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That'd be great!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I agree...
Anyway, Shizuku, mind getting back in the driver's seat?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Let's start by mixing some flour with water...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then we just rinse them off with cold water and let them breathe a little. For now, that'll be it for our dango-making segment.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While we wait, why don't we move on to our next segment?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ready, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: It's Happy Bunny Rabbit Time!

rows.Speaker: Everybody
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A moon viewing isn't a moon viewing without rabbits! In this segment, we'll be making rabbit masks and pretending to be cute little bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'd like it if you the viewers also joined us as we make our masks.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And while we make them, make sure to post some comments and suggestions for us. It'd also be great to hear about some of your own moon viewing stories.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I can't wait to see what they make.>
<I'm gonna make one too!>
<Moon viewings, huh? Haven't done one for a while...>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Cherry blossoms are one thing, but moon viewings?>
<Their dango looked good enough to sell at a store.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I wanna hear about some MMJ moon viewing stories.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our stories...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Any thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Care to share something with us, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me? Um, well...
It's not all that interesting but...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I wanna hear!>
<Yeah, Shizuku, give us a moon viewing story!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everybody seems very eager to hear from you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh wow...
In that case, if you'll allow...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a sister who's one year younger than me and we used to do moon viewings every year when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When we were in kindergarten, we even had a chance to make some rabbit-shaped dango together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even after we moved up to elementary school, we made sure to keep doing moon viewings on the night of the 15th. Hehe. It became a sort of family tradition for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two must be so close.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku loves her little sister very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I do.
Her name's Shii, and she's so cute and hard-working and... I don't know what I'd do without her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, our parents both work so it's difficult to plan family gatherings, but I never feel lonely as long as I have Shii there with me.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<They're BFFs.>
<I have a feeling that Shizuku's little sister is just like her.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I wish you could meet her and see just how cute she is. Not just that, she's a very strong girl too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's in a band with her friends and they just recently decided to start working towards becoming professionals.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll face their share of challenges, but I'm certain that they won't have any trouble overcoming them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like she has a really good work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, she really does!
Seeing her doing what she can to make her dreams come true has saved me in the past...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But at the same time, even if it's just occasionally, I wish she'd confide in me a little more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Confide in you...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's the type of person who helps others before helping herself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'd really like it if she saw me more as a source of comfort.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's such a good big sister.>
<Comfort us too, Shizuku...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A long time ago, when I was going through a bit of a tough time, Shii encouraged me by just being the hard-working girl that she is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She gave me the courage to stand back up and try again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'd like it if she would tell me when something's wrong or if she needs my help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's given me so much already, so I want to give back to her somehow.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez, she's telling everyone about what happened when we were just kids...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She was encouraged by me?
I never knew that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was sure that she was the one who's been keeping me afloat while I gave nothing back in return.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've faced your own share of hurdles as well and managed to overcome them, right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Isn't it fair to say that your sister received some encouragement after seeing you accomplish that just as you did when you saw her working so hard?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I've helped her? I really hope that's true...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line:
<That concludes this stream...
See you next time, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, it's over...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I should probably talk to her when I get home...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, you there? Hm? Whoa...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii, welcome home!
Our stream just ended and we're just about to have some dango.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
Um, Shizuku, about today...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku? Is someone there?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori, and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't realize you were all here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, uh... I'll come back and ask again later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, please, stay...
We've finished our stream so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Exactly. Would you like to have some dango with us, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, that's okay. I'll pass...
I'd feel bad since all your friends are here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, nonsense.
Please, Shii, come join us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, just look at this dango.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on...
Is that a rabbit...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we made them during our stream.
It's just like the ones you showed me how to make when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll make an exception today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone, allow me to introduce my younger sister, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And, Shii, this is MORE MORE JUMP!
Their names are...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Momoi, Kiritani and Minori...
Minori's in my class and I had a chance to talk to Kiritani already at the Seaside School since we were in the same group.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm Shiho Hinomori...
Thank you for always keeping an eye on my sister.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's our pleasure.
You seem so well-put-together too. Are you sure you're really the younger one here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Isn't she such a good girl?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're her big sister. Shouldn't she be the one looking up to you...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's nice to see you again.
I hope we can keep getting to know each other more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And don't hesitate to ask me about Haruka if you have any questions, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That goes for you too, Haruka!
I'll try to answer any questions you have about Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try? So I guess it's not anything goes with me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-Because Shizuku probably knows so much more about you than I do...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so feel free to ask anything you'd like about Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can't she just ask me directly?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Shii and I get to have a moon viewing party like this. I couldn't ask for more...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just thinking that it's such a beautiful night for a moon viewing. I'm sure the rabbit up there is smiling back at us too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The rabbit...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you might be right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You've given me so much too, so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Shii...
